phases.name: Pre-development and research
phases.scope: Evidence-based product, provider, market, security, UX and stack research; prototype and tests
exit_criteria: Primary-source research documented with checked dates and confidence
Stack ADR, data model, threat model, UX states and diagrams coherent
Synthetic end-to-end feasibility path and automated checks pass

phases.name: Repository foundation and DevOps
phases.scope: Monorepo, web/API, typed errors, auth/tenancy, persistence, audit, local install and CI
exit_criteria: Fresh npm ci and reproducible builds
Two authenticated tenants demonstrate API/worker/search isolation
Postgres and queue integration tests pass
Authenticated API and worker health checks pass
CI and setup smoke evidence recorded

phases.name: Provider connectivity and admin inventory
phases.scope: Capability engine, cPanel/WHM, IMAP discovery and connection UX
exit_criteria: Scoped live or explicitly marked mock connection tests
Provider permissions and capabilities exposed per resource
No content read without separate authorization

phases.name: Primary mail sync and unified inbox
phases.scope: Gmail, Graph and IMAP sync, inbox, drafts, sending and search
exit_criteria: Initial/incremental sync and recovery tests pass
Tenant ACL and privacy tests pass
Lost-send receipt remains UNKNOWN until reconciled

phases.name: Advanced operations and clients
phases.scope: Provider admin, DNS, migration, backup, incidents, automation, AI, web release, desktop, mobile and enterprise
exit_criteria: See governing master specification phases P4-P12
